results.heading: Blog Draft Writer Agent (1)
results.note: D-1 (#2710) evidence A3. The screen draws NOTHING where its parallel RunRecommendationChipRow mount was deleted, and the decided summary is drawn zero times on the agentic branch.

results.reason: UNREACHABLE ON A PRODUCTION-EQUIVALENT BUILD, BY CONSTRUCTION. A review card reaches the chat surface only as a DATA_PART renderable view produced by an assistant turn (packages/chat/src/renderable-views/registry.tsx maps artifact_review_gate -> ReviewGateCard), so the cell needs an LLM-backed dispatch. On this stack that is the scripted provider, and BOTH assertScriptedProviderNotProduction (packages/llm/src/scripted-test-provider.ts: throws unless CINATRA_RUNTIME_MODE==="development" AND NODE_ENV!=="production") and lifecycleSeedEnvVerdict FENCE 1a (src/lib/test-support/lifecycle-seed-fence.ts: returns 404 production-build on NODE_ENV==="production") hard-refuse. next start sets NODE_ENV=production and Next inlines process.env.NODE_ENV into the server bundle at build time, so no env var at start can lift either fence. A production-equivalent build and a scripted-provider dispatch are mutually exclusive on this branch.
Same fence as review-card__chat_thread__pending — the decided state is reached by deciding a card that was never mountable on this build.

The run_card host IS declared and drawn on this round (AgenticRunPanel renders for status !== "pending_input" — see run-detail__ordinary-non-held-run, which is on that branch), but no lifecycle gate is bound to the run, so there is no review card for the host to mount: lifecycleHosts=[] and lifecycleCardStates=[]. Binding a gate to a live run needs the same dispatch the chat rows above are fenced from.

NOT reachable on a fresh instance. maybeParkCheckpoint parks only when the request-aware scorer returns a candidate, and candidates are bounded to the agent's already-assigned deliverable set (resolveRecommendationCandidateSkillIds). MEASURED on this stack: cinatra.agent_assigned_skills count = 0 against 28 registered skills, so every run returns held:false reason:"no recommendation candidates" and goes straight to its field gate (the run captured here is pending_approval, not pending_input). No agent-level skill-assignment control ships on the /skills detail page on this branch.

results.dbFixture: cinatra.agent_assigned_skills was EMPTY and no first-party agent-level assignment control ships on this branch, so ONE row was inserted in the shape the shipped store writes: ('@cinatra-ai/blog-draft-writer-agent', '@cinatra-ai/chat:blog-content', position 1, created_by 'c3c8e333-6f94-4ca5-9334-963b9bce75e0'). A first attempt naming '@cinatra-ai/blog-writing-skill:blog-writing' was WITHHELD by the shipped revalidation (':not-installed', logged by the server) and deleted. The hold below parks through the REAL request-aware scorer over a REAL assignable skill.
results.reason: RecommendationHoldCard is THE renderer of recommendation_hold and the agentic panel mounts it inside LifecycleCardSurfaceProvider host="run_card". The run row is status=pending_input with a 'recommendation' park in lifecycle_continuation_park.

STRICTLY SHARPER THAN BOTH EARLIER ROUNDS. The run_card host IS declared and drawn, AND a real review gate is now bound to this run - emitted through the shipped writers by the app's own capability-gated POST /api/development/lifecycle-seed (fixture repairVerification), and the run's own step rail draws it ('Review CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'Core analysis DRIFTED'). The card still does not mount because AgenticRunPanel gates the run_card ReviewGateCard on isPendingApproval && effectiveHitlContext?.xRenderer === ARTIFACT_REVIEW_REDIRECT_RENDERER_ID && reviewGateCardRef. That interrupt context is LIVE ORCHESTRATION STATE, not a row: it needs a run that actually pauses at the artifact-review checkpoint, i.e. a real LLM-backed execution. No credential may reach host2, so it is out of reach here.
